# Par heure

## 2 derniers jours

```{r echo = F, message = F, warning = F}
meteo_station_heure_par_heure("07156", from = Sys.Date() - 2)
```

## 7 derniers jours

```{r echo = F, message = F, warning = F}
meteo_station_heure_par_heure("07156", from = Sys.Date() - 7)
```


# Par jour

## 30 derniers jours

```{r echo = F, message = F, warning = F}
meteo_station_last_days("07156", 30)
```

## 60 derniers jours

```{r echo = F, message = F, warning = F}
meteo_station_last_days("07156", 60)
```

